title: Senior Tech Hub
summary: A founder-led initiative helping seniors, families and first-time technology users build confidence with everyday digital tools.
challenge: Everyday technology can feel difficult or risky when support is rushed, technical or intimidating. Senior Tech Hub is built around patient, practical learning that respects each person’s pace.
approach: Create a human-centred learning ecosystem: clear guidance, practical resources, small-group and one-to-one support, and community partnerships.
nextOpportunity: Develop the resource library and community workshop model.

title: Tech Tips Africa
role: Educational content programme connected to Senior Tech Hub
summary: A practical education and awareness programme sharing simple digital tips for everyday life across Africa.
challenge: Digital guidance often relies on jargon or fear. The programme focuses on relevant problems people and families actually encounter, with steps they can save or print.
approach: Use simple English, short steps, practical examples and a calm, beginner-friendly tone across newsletter and educational content.

title: South Africa–West Africa Trade & Procurement
summary: A developing B2B concept for connecting buyers and suppliers across South Africa and West Africa.
approach: The proposed direction is low-capital, asset-light and partnership-driven, with a focus on supplier and buyer relationships.
nextOpportunity: Clarify the concept and potential partners before describing any operational activity.

title: PayGuard Prototype
summary: A public prototype exploring a family review and approval flow for transactions. Its risk signals and approval steps are simulated.
challenge: Explore how a family review step could fit into a transaction flow without presenting a demo as a live financial service.
approach: A public Node/Express prototype models transactions in memory and demonstrates heuristic risk indicators and simulated approval states.
